source_handling: Frozen local UART extracts came from the already-running G2-Web capture. No serial open/close/reset or new device query by the agent; original running capture was not modified.
public_derivatives: RUN.json copied as OWNER_LOG.json; field-selected screenshot observations/timeline; heartbeat rows parsed to CSV; non-heartbeat payloads retained with CRLF normalized to LF. No invented request rows or latency percentiles.
screenshots: Owner supplied screenshots inline in chat. No image files were exposed in the workspace attachment directory; no local file, SHA-256, or repository screenshot publication is asserted. Public evidence contains visual transcriptions; original screenshots remain in the conversation. This limits independently hash-bound image verification.
privacy: No passwords, cookies, tokens, HTTP headers/bodies, HAR, browser profile, complete UART history or private flash readbacks are included. Existing C5 identity is referenced from the earlier sanitized IMAGE_IDENTITY.json.
limitations: Raw browser network archive unavailable; cannot assert 100% of all browser requests succeeded
Exact client close/reopen times and initial full transport error class unavailable
B2 and B3 exceeded planned durations; receipt-based durations do not equal exactly measured browser exposure
Owner confirmed manual reload/revisit after first B4 failure; no claim of immediate stop at that first error
Screenshot transcription is not a full network trace; exact error text is not guessed
Earlier check may show a slightly negative heartbeat age because check time preceded file scan completion; final summary uses a frozen bounded interval and does not use those ages as timing proof
